title: The derived category of modules supported on a closed subset is equivalent to the derived category of the closed subspace, with the functor as right adjoint reconstruction
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves), section on cohomology with support
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes three facts for the inclusion i : Z -> X of a closed subset: that i_* lands in D_Z(O_X), that i_* : D(O_X|_Z) -> D_Z(O_X) is an equivalence with quasi-inverse i^{-1} = R-H_Z on D_Z, and that i_* composed with R-H_Z is right adjoint to the inclusion D_Z(O_X) -> D(O_X). The substantive part is the equivalence: it uses exactness of i_* and i^* = i^{-1} for a closed immersion to get full faithfulness, then proves the adjunction map K -> i_*i^{-1}K is an isomorphism for K supported on Z by reducing to cohomology sheaves and applying the support hypothesis (proof lines 8565-8584). The final identification R-H_Z(K) = i^{-1}K on D_Z then reduces to the cited computation on the support (proof lines 8586-8591). H3: an equivalence of triangulated categories proved through adjunction and cohomology-sheaf reduction is research-level, not a routine formal consequence.
